plugin_description: Now-playing widget that mirrors the builtin media widget and scrolls the phone volume over KDE Connect.

hide_artist.label: Hide artist
hide_artist.description: Show only the track title, not the artist.

artist_first.label: Artist first
artist_first.description: Order the label as artist then title.

album_art_only.label: Album art only
album_art_only.description: Collapse to just the cover, hiding the title and controls.

hide_album_art.label: Hide album art
hide_album_art.description: Drop the cover and show the title and controls only.

show_progress.label: Show progress
show_progress.description: Draw a thin playback progress bar under the widget.

hide_when_no_media.label: Hide when no media
hide_when_no_media.description: Remove the widget from the bar when nothing is playing.

title_scroll.label: Title scroll
title_scroll.description: When to marquee a title too long to fit.

max_length.label: Max length
max_length.description: Widest the title area is allowed to grow, in pixels.

art_size.label: Art size
art_size.description: Cover art edge length, in pixels.
